title: Agent Recommendation Record
description: A machine-readable recommendation emitted by a read-only monitoring or audit agent. It is safe to display to a human, to store, or to hand to a separate remediation-orchestrator agent for an approval-gated change plan. Producing a recommendation record never executes anything.

id.description: Stable identifier for this recommendation, unique within the producing agent run (for example, alarm-fatigue-2026-08-14-cpu-prod-api).

producedBy.description: The agent name that produced this recommendation, matching agent-config.json name.

producedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the recommendation was produced.

title.description: One-line human-readable title naming the resource and the fix.

finding.description: What was observed and why it is a problem. Grounded in data, not speculation.

evidence.description: The specific observed data points that justify the finding. Every recommendation must cite at least one.

source.description: Where the value came from, for example a CloudWatch metric name or an AWS API operation (cloudwatch GetMetricStatistics CPUUtilization, ec2 DescribeSnapshots).

value.description: The observed value or summary, for example p95 CPUUtilization 12 percent over 14 days, or snapshot has no source volume.

observedAt.description: When the value was observed, used to judge freshness.

target.description: The specific resource the recommendation applies to.

service.description: AWS service, for example ec2, rds, s3, cloudwatch.

resourceId.description: Resource identifier or ARN. Reference by identifier; do not embed secrets.

accountId.description: Account identifier. Treated as HIGH sensitivity; may be masked in stored output.

proposedAction.description: The change being proposed. This is a proposal only; the producing agent cannot execute it.

summary.description: Plain-language description of the specific change, naming the resource and the exact setting or value.

implementation.description: Optional concrete implementation the executor could use after approval. Never auto-run by the producing agent.

type.description: How the change would be applied.

content.description: The command, document name, or template snippet. Must not contain a prohibited action (see prohibitedActionCheck).

rollback.description: Explicit steps to revert the change if it makes things worse. Required for any change that is not read-only.

safetyRating.description: GREEN read-only or no state change; YELLOW state-changing but recoverable; RED destructive or hard to reverse.

reversible.description: Whether the proposed change can be reverted.

requiresApproval.description: Whether a human must approve before the change is applied. Must be true for YELLOW and RED.

escalationRequired.description: Whether the change meets an escalation condition in SECURITY.md (IAM in production, security controls, KMS key policy, aws-auth, SCP, CloudTrail, encryption, cross-account or cross-region blast radius, data loss or exposure).

prohibitedActionCheck.description: Result of checking the proposed action against the SECURITY.md prohibited actions list. A downstream executor must refuse any record where this is failed.

blastRadius.description: Scope of impact if the change is applied.

estimatedMonthlySavingsUsd.description: Optional estimated monthly cost saving if the change is a cost optimization.

confidence.description: Confidence in the finding given data completeness. Low confidence should lower severity, not inflate it.

owner.description: Suggested owning team, derived from resource tags where available.

notes.description: Optional caveats, assumptions, or data gaps affecting this recommendation.
